name: Multi-scale L2 Loss Optimization with Random Variable Perturbation
definition: An optimization method that matches shader parameters to target images using a multi-scale L2 loss and uniformly distributed random variables added to Dirac parameters to avoid local minima.
summary: Multi-scale L2 Loss Optimization with Random Variable Perturbation optimizes shader parameters by alternating resolution objectives and perturbing non-ray-marching variables to escape local minima in differentiable rendering.
